title: Moving Average (Variable Frequency)
text: 可变频率移动平均值计算，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Initial frequency (Hz)} 指定信号初始频率；{Minimum frequency (Hz)} 指定信号最小频率、{Initial value} 指定输入信号初始值、{Buffer size} 指定缓冲区大小、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间，按实例取值。

ports.name: u
ports.summary: 移动平均输入 scalar | vector

ports.name: Mean
ports.summary: 移动平均输出 scalar | vector

params.name: Initial frequency (Hz)
params.values: 信号初始频率 60 (default) | positive scalar | vector with positive values

params.name: Minimum frequency (Hz)
params.values: 信号最小频率 30 (default) | positive scalar | vector with positive values

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
